name: Brass Whistle
tagline: The back office for people who'd rather be with the dogs.
positioning: Brass Whistle runs the boring half of your grooming, walking, or daycare business so you can spend the day covered in fur instead of paperwork.

hero.h1: Your appointment book shouldn't need a nap.
hero.sub: Brass Whistle handles bookings, deposits, no-show fees, and vaccination reminders for grooming salons, dog walkers, and daycares — so the front desk stops eating your afternoon.

features.title: Bookings that don't double-book
features.description: Clients pick real open slots from your live calendar. No more three Labradoodles arriving at 9am because someone texted you on a walk.

features.title: Deposits and no-show fees
features.description: Take a card up front, keep the deposit when they ghost you. Brass Whistle charges it automatically so you never have the awkward conversation.

features.title: Pet profiles that remember for you
features.description: Breed, temperament, allergies, that one clipper guard number, and which dog bites the vacuum — all attached to the client, all searchable.

features.title: Vaccination reminders on autopilot
features.description: We nag clients about expiring rabies records so you don't have to turn anyone away at the door — or risk your license doing it.

features.title: Staff schedules without the group chat
features.description: Assign groomers and walkers by skill and shift. Everyone sees their day on their phone before the coffee's cold.

features.title: Numbers a human can read
features.description: Weekly revenue, rebooking rate, and which service actually pays the rent — in plain language, not a spreadsheet you'll never open.

testimonials.quote: I used to run my grooming schedule on a paper diary and pure spite. Brass Whistle cut my no-shows by half and I stopped answering texts at 11pm. That alone is worth the money.
testimonials.name: Danielle Roarke

testimonials.quote: Three walkers, forty dogs, one very confused group chat. Now everyone gets their route on their phone and I get my evenings back. The deposit feature paid for the whole subscription in a month.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: The vaccination reminders quietly saved me from a very bad afternoon. Clients update their records before drop-off now instead of arguing with my front desk. Wildly boring, wildly effective.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadal

pricing.blurb: For the one-person show who is also the front desk.
For small teams who share a calendar and a caffeine problem.

homepage.footerBlurb: Brass Whistle is software for the humans behind the leash. Fewer spreadsheets, fewer no-shows, more time with the actual animals.
